title: Cooking loss
summary: How much weight a preparation loses when it is cooked.

net-weight.label: Clean weight
net-weight.placeholder: Weight of the clean product before cooking, in kg (e.g. 1.200)

additions-weight.label: Inseparable additions
additions-weight.placeholder: Sauces, coatings or fillings that can't be separated, in kg (e.g. 0.300)

cooked-weight.label: Cooked weight
cooked-weight.placeholder: Weight of the cooked product, in kg (e.g. 1.050)

steps.weight-before-cooking: Before cooking = clean weight + additions = {netWeight} kg + {additionsWeight} kg = {weightBeforeCooking} kg
steps.loss-weight: Loss = before cooking − cooked = {weightBeforeCooking} kg − {cookedWeight} kg = {lossWeight} kg
steps.loss-percentage: Cooking loss % = loss ÷ before cooking × 100 = {lossWeight} kg ÷ {weightBeforeCooking} kg × 100 = {lossPercentage}

roast-with-marinade.title: Marinated meat: 1.200 kg + 0.300 kg marinade ending at 1.050 kg

errors.cooked-weight.must-not-exceed-gross: The cooked weight can't be greater than the weight before cooking.
